links.outcome: LLM accuracy on pediatric surgery scenario diagnosis, investigation, treatment decisions vs surgeon reference
links.effect: Claude 145/150 (Po=0.967); ChatGPT and Gemini 144/150 (0.960); DeepSeek-V3 0.913; Perplexity 0.873, significantly different from surgeon (p=0.004). Errors clustered in investigation and treatment.
links.quote: In the overall analysis, only Perplexity demonstrated a performance level significantly different from that of the pediatric surgeon (p = 0.004).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic and treatment decision performance of five LLMs across 50 pediatric surgery clinical vignettes compared to expert pediatric surgeons, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
